The field of 65 was drawn mainly from Youth Clubs and pre-Service Units. Ken Cuff led from the start and beat the local favourite, H. Rouse (whose father is one of our walkers), by four seconds in 20mins. 22secs.
Rouse, jun., to beat the course record by 40 seconds. Result—1 H. Rouse (jun.), 20.31; 2 Weames, 20.32; 15 Stanford, 22.35.
Bob Readman and Harry Rouse finished second and third respectively in the Police Ten and the following Saturday we met with success in the Surrey County Race, R.

Harry Rouse and Joe Wilson, badly affected by the blizzard-like weather, dropped well back, making Sid Spencer, 34th, our second man home. By this time next year, however, we hope to have a much stronger junior team with which we shall no doubt make our presence felt.

As the National Junior Race will be over before this issue is out, little need be said, but young Mac's present form is good enough to annexe the individual title and that he will receive good support from Bert East, Harry Rouse, Joe Wilson and others.

Bert East, still showing improvement, made his way to the front, with Harry Rouse and Reg Elson filling the other places. In the London to Brighton race which marks the end of the summer season, we encoutered the same bad luck which had befallen us in the other distance races.
